description: This source file defines an interface for univariate root-finding algorithms within the Apache Commons Math library. It includes method signatures for configuring and executing root searches, as well as retrieving solver properties.

classes.name: BaseUnivariateSolver
classes.description: An interface that specifies methods for univariate root-finding algorithms, including evaluation limits, accuracy settings, and solving methods.

methods.name: getMaxEvaluations
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of function evaluations allowed for the solver.

methods.name: getEvaluations
methods.description: Returns the number of function evaluations performed in the last solve attempt.

methods.name: getAbsoluteAccuracy
methods.description: Returns the absolute error tolerance for the solution.

methods.name: getRelativeAccuracy
methods.description: Returns the relative error tolerance for the solution.

methods.name: getFunctionValueAccuracy
methods.description: Returns the acceptable function value accuracy at the solution.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Performs root-finding within the specified interval with a maximum number of evaluations.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Performs root-finding within the specified interval starting at a given initial point.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Performs root-finding near a specified start value.
